causal_hypothesis: A deterministic selector using high-confidence current-output multi-order matches and prompt-copy matches, with exact native v0.5.15 BFS NGRAM as fallback, can accept more output tokens per target pass than native NGRAM alone.
candidate: output-history order>=2 with support>=2; else prompt-copy order>=4; else native BFS NGRAM
correctness_gate: Proposal functions receive only prompt_ids and the already-emitted output prefix; all proposed tokens are compared with the target trace only after proposal construction.
promotion_gate: At least 20% fewer fixed target-verifier rows than native NGRAM on both endpoint rows 0..790 and the 198 captured GPQA rows, with deterministic causal proposals and nonpathological CPU lookup cost.
stock_control: Exact source-equivalent v0.5.15 BFS NGRAM: max trie depth 18, breadth 1..10, 11 draft nodes plus root, chronological shared trie.
target_metrics: fixed and logical target rows per emitted token
transfer_limit: Trace replay supports a proposal-source decision only; it does not establish serving latency or GPU speedup.
